rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot, and yes, there's something concrete. Halcyon Threshold's first project is a \"neglected measurements\" map: a survey of safety-relevant AI behaviors and capabilities that nobody is publicly measuring, so funders and researchers can see the gaps. Your data skills fit perfectly. A first task that fits in ~5 hrs/week: build a simple structured dataset of existing public evals/benchmarks (name, what it measures, who maintains it, last updated, link). I'll share a starter spreadsheet and a short list of sources this week. From there we can identify the gaps together. If that sounds good, reply and I'll set you up. And thanks again for stepping up. Morgan Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Priya Raman: accepted her offer; assigned her the evals-catalogue as a first task (~5 hrs/wk).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Great to meet you too, and thanks for the details. I'm planning to submit a two-page proposal with budget well before the 30 November deadline — it will be for a small, concrete project mapping neglected measurement gaps in AI safety (and building evals for the top gaps). I'll be the named, accountable applicant as you describe. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Idris Bellamy (Emberfall): confirmed we'll apply by 30 Nov.
